requirements.requirement: Tidy storage for small sewing supplies (compartmentalized organizer to sort bobbins, buttons, needles, etc.)
requirements.evidence: 3-cell base (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) with 3 bins providing 7 compartments: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) + bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) + bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments). Different division sizes allow sorting of varied small notions.

requirements.requirement: Visible, accessible organization (can see and reach supplies)
requirements.evidence: Open bins at yMm 11 with headroom 72mm and flush covers cover:0,0,0;full;top + cover:1,0,0;full;top forming deck f32 (310x227 mm) for work surface; check_build meshClash clear, no errors.

requirements.requirement: Hang / side storage for sewing tools (e.g., scissors, tape measure)
requirements.evidence: Two wall hooks (accessory:0#0,0#2, accessory:0#0,0#3) and rods (accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#0) provide hang points (surfaces f33,f34 mount). No sewing-specific tool props exist in catalog (find_props for 'sewing','scissors','thread','needle','button','bobbin' returned 0), so not dressed with literal sewing tools; generic workshop proxies exist but no sewing tool prop to demonstrate.

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell hexagonal organizer with 7 compartments across three bins plus a dual-cover deck and hook/rod hang points, providing tidy, sortable storage for small sewing notions. Configurator is fit-only (3D-printed plastic) and has no sewing-specific props like thread spools, bobbins or scissors to dress; bins demonstrate the function.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
